page.overview:
Who is Bruel Sunderchin?

Bruel Sunderchin was a Dwarven male entrepreneur and founder of the Brawlers' League.

As an entrepreneur, he was described as a "rough-and-tumble"; indeed, as he was one of multiple strong, charismatic "ruffians" who took advantage of the dire social status of the Kingdom of Drassig to gain social power for themselves.

Bruel Sunderchin was a dwarven male from Kraghammer who was born in the era of the Kingdom of Drassig, during which many of the social elite in Emon would use their wealth to pay the lower class to fight to the death for their amusement. Sunderchin was one of many "ruffians" who used this to his advantage by reaching out to his network of criminals and becoming the ringleader of an annual gladiator tournament that catered to the wealthy elite of Exandria known as the Brawlers' League.

Sunderchin has at least one descendant, Oben Sunderchin, who was alive during the time of the Chroma Crisis.
